body.rail_groove_method: expanded actual sampled rail envelope, continuously swept outward, projected through hoop print thickness
body.assembly: Dry-fit beam modules, then glue beam to pier saddles. Place keyed hoops in numbered seats. Lay in each outside-open rail track; glue ends at module boundaries.
body.limitations: Glue assembly; print supports needed for beam and rails. Thin rails are non-load-bearing and must be handled carefully. Fit clearance has not been physically calibrated.

head.inlay_seating: three positive lands per insert at the intended visible face level
head.eye_surround: integral raised cream borders; true aperture retained

foot_pins.lead_in: female tray mouth only; flat pin nose preserves support-free print contact
female tray mouth only; flat pin nose preserves support-free print contact

head.platform_assembly: vertical top drop before head is fixed to the base
head.first_hoop_receiver: continuous 0–4 mm vertical insertion sweep plus 0.25 mm XYZ clearance
head.lamination_registration: external head-outline jig; whole D-flat pins remain on the inner half

entrance.tail_wall_assembly: four cream half panels laminated in pairs; two blue and two angular orange inserts; two separate flat-printing cream handrails with locating posts
entrance.ladder_assembly: straight horizontal comb insertion from +X toward -X at final height; nominal 0.30 mm clearance. Glue lower feet to sand and upper frame via accessible glue pads; do not force against head.

coupon.purpose: Quick PLA fit calibration before the full kit; test pieces are not assembly components.
coupon.interpretation: Use the smallest clearance that seats fully with light finger pressure and can be removed. Two ticks matches the kit default. If only another column works, adjust mating sockets or calibrated slicer compensation and rerun the coupon before the full kit.
coupon.limitation: General clearance comparison only. Also print the actual interface samples with their supplied orientations and supports; those test curved rails, shoulders, D-feet, platform, ladder and colour inserts.
